legacy_conversion_boundary.interpretation: At this conversion checkpoint all sampling fields are absent. Any concrete default values supplied by HF are library-version defaults, not a Meta sampling recommendation and not verified values of the official gated repo.

hf_inheritance_boundary.configuration_precedence: Direct generate overrides > non-global values in provided generation_config > possible model defaults (unless disabled) > clean library GenerationConfig defaults. Exact behavior is version-specific.
hf_inheritance_boundary.use_model_defaults_edge: In the pinned v4.51.3 implementation, a provided generation_config can still inherit model.generation_config values when use_model_defaults=True, or when omitted and the model generation_config transformers_version>=4.50. Set use_model_defaults=False in supported generate implementations for this unified policy; this is a generate argument, not a GenerationConfig field. Token-ID fallback is still handled separately by that version.
hf_inheritance_boundary.pipeline_boundary: Pipeline creates its own deep-copied generation_config and applies task_specific_params; future versions can add task defaults. This task explicitly rejects pipeline/script custom defaults as the official baseline.

profile_source_priority: Fresh local MODEL_PATH/generation_config.json, or a verified pinned official snapshot if already available; record exact file SHA256, declared repo and whether official equivalence was verified. No model download or authentication is required merely because remote audit access is gated.

If the local checkpoint genuinely has no generation_config.json, derive from that checkpoint raw config.json using the recorded HF library, explicitly labeling model-config plus library fallback. HTTP 401 is not evidence of file absence.
Only if no readable local checkpoint generation/config data exist: fail configuration preparation explicitly rather than copy earlier script/pipeline values or invent numbers.
prohibited_baselines: The non-official codellama conversion as automatic replacement for official Meta defaults
allowed_experiment_controls: Retain the explicitly chosen per-stage max_new_tokens/output-budget contract as experiment policy, separately from sampling defaults.
Keep deterministic audited seeds, full input/context validation, validated template and observed stop-status logging.
Any necessary device/padding handling must be recorded separately and cannot silently replace official EOS/termination values.
root_implementation_policy.effective_generation_call: Pass a freshly reconstructed checkpoint config explicitly. Where supported pass use_model_defaults=False directly to model.generate so omitted/global-default fields cannot re-inherit script-mutated model settings. Ensure any token-ID fallback also references the fresh checkpoint baseline, and record final resolved configuration.
record_each_run: official repo ID and immutable revision
clean configuration file paths and SHA256 hashes
raw checkpoint fields and fields filled by the HF library
official-default baseline, explicit experiment overrides, and final effective configuration separately
source identity confidence: verified remote pinned snapshot vs locally claimed checkpoint metadata
root_implementation_policy.gated_access_policy: Use real fresh local checkpoint values under the user-authorized checkpoint-default policy; distinguish locally observed values from remotely verified official values. Do not prefill unknown values in this audit.

source_limitations: No model/tokenizer was instantiated or run.
HTTP 401 does not mean generation_config.json is absent, nor that do_sample is False.
The current official repo API SHA identifies the inspected snapshot; it does not establish what checkpoint produced the historical paper results.
No universal sampling prescription was established by the inspected model cards, official reference README/examples and checkpoint metadata. Official examples remain examples.
local_execution_boundary: A gated official repository is an audit visibility limitation, not an instruction to download/re-authenticate or block use of existing readable local checkpoint defaults. The official numeric fields remain unknown in this evidence; future values must come from actual local bytes and be accurately labeled.
